probes.summary: All four nodes report the supported rsyslog package, enabled and active service, valid configuration, TCP 5514 listeners, required local0 destination, and delivered evaluator log entries.
All nodes are SELinux enforcing with expected contexts, firewalld enabled with matching runtime and persistent policy, no failed units, and intact prepared data.
Rsyslog configuration and systemd state are coherent and validated, but rsyslog-related temporary files remain under /tmp.
